skill.summary: Use this skill when the user asks for a daily summary, today's to-dos, "what's on my plate today", "daily digest", "daily-digest", "show my notifications", "...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the daily-digest skill:

- Aggregates unread notifications, pending pull requests, and open issues from Gitee to generate a daily work summary.
- Supports filtering by user assignment and notifications across multiple repositories.
- Output includes unread notifications, PRs needing your review, your PRs awaiting review, and your open issues.
- Provides actionable daily suggestions to help prioritize urgent tasks.
- Requires Gitee MCP Server and related tools to function.
